task_description: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) requires finding the shortest Hamiltonian cycle through a set of 2D cities. The goal is to evolve the tour construction heuristic to minimize total tour length. The baseline uses a KD-tree with two-phase nearest neighbor search, k-means clustering for start point selection, and bidirectional local search, but there is significant room for improvement through better construction strategies and local optimization techniques like 2-opt.

metrics.name: tour_length
metrics.description: Total Euclidean distance of the tour including the return edge from the last city back to the first city. This is the primary optimization objective.
